VR.title: Google & Samsung Reveal Smart Glasses for Fall Launch, Aiming to go Head-to-head with Meta
VR.summary: Google and Samsung unveiled smart glasses set to rival Meta's offerings, showcasing their potential at Google I/O.

VR.summary: Google launched the Android XR Developer Catalyst Program at I/O, providing dev kits for upcoming AR glasses.

VR.summary: LetinAR, a South Korean AR lens startup, raised $18.5 million ahead of its planned IPO next year to boost production.

VR.summary: The remakes of the classic games Myst and Riven are now available on PlayStation VR2, enhancing the VR gaming experience.
